name: Logitech G304 Lightspeed Wireless
details: 🎯 Next-gen HERO Optical Sensor – Delivers up to 12,000 DPI, 400 IPS precision, and exceptional responsiveness for competition-level accuracy.
⚡ LIGHTSPEED Wireless – Ultra-fast 1 ms report rate ensures lag-free gaming with tournament-grade performance.
🔋 Long Battery Life – Up to 250 hours of continuous gameplay on one AA battery in Performance mode; up to 9 months in Endurance mode.
🚨 Battery Indicator – Flashes red at 15% battery remaining, so you’ll never be caught off guard.
🪶 Lightweight Design – Weighs just 99g for effortless, high-speed maneuverability.
🖱️ 6 Programmable Buttons – Fully customizable via Logitech G HUB software for macros and key bindings.
💼 Compact & Durable – Built-in nano receiver storage makes it travel-friendly for gaming on the go.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste 2 Wireless
cons: Ngenuity software only available for Windows
details: 🔗 Dual Wireless Connectivity – Supports both 2.4GHz wireless with dongle and Bluetooth mode for seamless device compatibility.
🔋 Long-lasting Battery – Up to 100 hours of battery life on a full charge, keeping you in the game longer with fewer interruptions.
⚡ Ultra-lightweight Design – Solid upper shell with only 61g total weight, enabling faster movements and reduced fatigue during intense gaming.
🎯 HyperX 26K Sensor – Native 26,000 DPI with tracking speeds up to 650 IPS, ensuring incredible precision and responsiveness for competitive gaming.
🖱️ Customization Ready – Fully customizable with HyperX NGENUITY software, including DPI settings, macros, and RGB options.
🔌 Play While Charging – Continue gaming while charging for uninterrupted performance during long sessions.
🦾 Premium Build – Equipped with durable HyperX mechanical switches rated for longevity and consistent click feel.
🏎️ Smooth Glide – PTFE skates and grip tape included, ensuring enhanced control and effortless mouse movement.

name: Logitech G502 HERO
details: 🎯 Next-Gen HERO Sensor – Delivers ultra-precise tracking up to 25,600 DPI with zero smoothing, filtering, or acceleration.
🖱️ 11 Programmable Buttons – Fully customizable control with dual-mode hyper-fast scroll wheel for versatile gameplay and productivity.
⚖️ Adjustable Weight System – Configure up to five 3.6g weights for a personalized balance between 121g and 139g.
🌈 LIGHTSYNC RGB – Customize with 16.8 million colors and sync effects with your games, audio, or screen via Logitech G HUB software.
🔘 Mechanical Switch Tensioning – Metal spring tensioning system with pivot hinges for crisp, clean clicks and rapid feedback.
🖐️ Ergonomic Grip – Textured rubber grips designed for long-lasting comfort and precise control during intense sessions.
🔄 Dual-Mode Scroll Wheel – Switch between hyper-fast scrolling and ratcheted precision with a single toggle.
💪 Built to Last – Durable mechanical switches paired with premium build quality for extended reliability.

name: SteelSeries Rival 3
pros: True 1:1 tracking with 8,500 CPI, 300 IPS speed
details: 🛡️ Hyper-Durable Build – Constructed with high-grade polymer materials designed for long-lasting durability.
🎯 TrueMove Core Sensor – True 1:1 tracking with 8,500 CPI, 300 IPS speed, and 35G acceleration for precise performance.
🖐️ Ergonomic Comfort – Lightweight (77g) design with split-trigger buttons for comfort and responsiveness in extended gaming sessions.
🌈 Prism RGB Lighting – Features 3-zone Prism RGB with 16.8 million crisp colors and customizable effects.
💾 On-Board Memory – Save polling rate, keybinds, and up to five CPI profiles directly on the mouse.
⚡ 6 Programmable Buttons – Assign macros, actions, or keybinds to optimize gameplay.
🎮 Designed for Esports – Lightweight yet sturdy construction optimized for both competitive and casual play.

name: Razer Cobra
details: 🪶 Ultra-Lightweight Design – Weighs only 58g, optimized for fast, precise control across most grip styles.
⚡ Gen-3 Optical Mouse Switches – Rated for 90 million clicks with 0.2 ms actuation and no debounce delay, ensuring speed and durability.
🌈 Razer Chroma RGB Lighting – Features gradient underglow with 16.8 million colors, reactive effects, and dynamic game integration.
🎯 Precise DPI Adjustments – Customize sensitivity in fine 50 DPI increments for a fully personalized playstyle.
🔗 Razer Speedflex Cable – Ultra-flexible cable designed to minimize drag, enabling smoother swipes and higher control.
🦾 100% PTFE Mouse Feet – Premium-grade PTFE skates (front, rear, and sensor ring) for seamless gliding on any surface.
🎮 Built for Endurance – Ergonomic construction built for long gaming sessions with comfort and responsiveness.

name: Razer DeathAdder V2 X
details: 🏆 Award-Winning Ergonomic Design – Trusted by over 13 million fans, with a shape that has supported pro players, including Faker, for optimal grip and comfort.
⚡ Ultra-Fast Razer HyperSpeed Wireless – Low-latency 2.4GHz wireless technology ensures smooth and responsive gameplay for competitive performance.
🔋 Long Battery Life – Up to 235 hours in HyperSpeed Wireless mode and up to 615 hours via Bluetooth, minimizing interruptions during long gaming sessions.
🎛️ Razer Mechanical Mouse Switches Gen-2 – Gold-plated contact points ensure crisp, consistent clicks with a lifespan of up to 60 million clicks.
🎯 Razer 5G Advanced 14K DPI Optical Sensor – High-precision tracking for pixel-perfect aiming with zero smoothing, filtering, or acceleration.
🖱️ 7 Programmable Buttons – Customize macros and keybindings for gaming or productivity.
🦾 Built for Endurance – Lightweight and durable construction designed for long sessions without fatigue.

name: Asus TUF Gaming M3
details: 🖱️ Ultralight, Ergonomic Design – Weighs just 59 grams with a shell crafted for right-handed gamers, providing comfort during long sessions.
🎯 8000 DPI Optical Sensor – Delivers pixel-precise tracking with a DPI button to switch between four sensitivity levels on the fly.
💧 IP56 Dust & Water Resistance – Protective coating ensures long-lasting durability and reliability in various environments.
🦠 ASUS Antibacterial Guard – Inhibits bacterial growth to keep the mouse surface and buttons clean and sanitary.
⚡ Complete Control – PTFE mouse feet allow swift, smooth glides for precise cursor control.
🎛️ Customizable Settings – Six tactile programmable buttons with three onboard memory profiles for full flexibility.
💻 Easy Configuration – Armoury Crate software enables intuitive configuration, macros, and infinite RGB lighting possibilities.
📏 High-Speed Performance – Supports 30g max acceleration and 200 IPS resolution for fast and accurate movements.

name: Logitech G203 Wired
details: 🏆 Trusted Brand – Logitech, the world’s #1 gaming gear brand based on global sales data (Feb 2019–Feb 2020), ensures quality and reliability.
🎯 8,000 DPI Gaming-Grade Sensor – Responds precisely to movements, with customizable sensitivity settings via Logitech G HUB software, allowing cycling through up to 5 DPI presets.
⌨️ Classic 6-Button Layout – Comfortable, time-tested design for extended gaming sessions, with each button fully programmable via Logitech G HUB software.

🌈 LIGHTSYNC RGB – Vibrant dual-zone color wave effects, customizable across 16.8 million colors with preset animations or user-defined effects. Includes game-driven audio visualization and screen mapping.
🔌 USB-A Connection – Reliable wired connection for consistent performance and minimal latency.
💻 Software Customization – Logitech G HUB enables easy setup of DPI, button mapping, lighting effects, and macros for full personalization.

name: Razer Orochi V2
details: 🎯 60g Ultra-Lightweight Design – Optimized for fast, precise movements and natural fit for most grip styles during extended gaming sessions.
⌨️ 2nd-Gen Razer Mechanical Mouse Switches – Improved click durability and consistency for up to 60 million clicks, delivering crisp tactile feedback.
🖱️ Razer 5G Advanced 18K DPI Optical Sensor – High-precision sensor provides pixel-perfect tracking and responsive aim for competitive gaming.
🔗 Dual-Mode Wireless – Connect via 2.4GHz or Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) for flexible and reliable performance across multiple devices.
🔋 Long Battery Life – Up to 950 hours of gameplay on a single charge in efficient mode, minimizing downtime during gaming.
🛡️ Warranty & Reliability – 1-year manufacturer warranty ensures support and quality assurance for long-term use.

name: Razer Basilisk V3
details: 🎛️ 11 Programmable Buttons – Assign all macros and secondary functions across 11 programmable buttons, including the multi-function trigger, for push-to-talk, ping, and more.
🌈 11 Razer Chroma RGB Lighting Zones – Customize each zone with over 16.8 million colors and dynamic effects, reacting to 150+ Chroma-integrated games.
⌨️ Razer Optical Mouse Switches Gen-2 – Zero unintended misclicks with crisp, responsive execution at 0.2 ms actuation speed for up to 70 million clicks.
🖱️ Razer Focus 26K DPI Optical Sensor – Best-in-class sensor with intelligent functions and zero smoothing, delivering pixel-precise accuracy and flawless movement tracking.
🔄 Razer HyperScroll Tilt Wheel – Switch between free-spin and tactile mode for precise control and smooth scrolling, ideal for cycling through weapons or skills.
🛡️ Iconic Ergonomic Design with Thumb Rest – Signature form factor supports your hand naturally while positioning buttons for quick, easy access.
